newsitem.title: USA: Cabletron denies in talks to buy FORE.
newsitem.headline: Cabletron denies in talks to buy FORE.

text.p: Cabletron Systems Inc on Friday denied it was in talks to acquire FORE Systems Inc.
Market rumors about such merger talks drove up shares of FORE in heavy trading.
"We are not in any negotiations to acquire FORE" said Cabletron spokesman Darren Orzechowski.
"We have a close partnership with FORE and we just renewed that partnership, but we are not in talks to acquire them," said Orzechowski.
FORE shares rose 1-9/16 to 15-1/8 on the takeover rumors, traders said. The stock was one of the the most heavily traded issues on the Nasdaq.
Cabletron shares also surged, rising 1-1/4 to 29-7/8 at midday.
After the Cabletron statement, traders said there was still widespread betting that FORE might be in talks with other suitors.
Pittsburgh-based FORE was not immediately available for comment.
FORE provides networking computer products based on asynchronous transfer mode (ATM) technology.
